statement: A pre-emptive abstention keyed on a file's path shape, decided before any per-criterion collector runs, discards readable evidence the collector would have measured. Incident: cejel's repo-signal inventory mapped an oversized file (over its own declared read cap) to rubric criteria by filename shape alone, wiping each criterion wholesale even when other readable content already satisfied it. Field instance: a 6.3KB README answering criterion A5 was abstained anyway because two unrelated oversized .txt fixtures matched A5's doc-extension shape; a same-commit comparison read 3.1/4.0 over 9/9 criteria unaffected vs 1.5/4.0 over 5/10 affected. Fix: delete the path-shape mapping and its call sites; each criterion's collector decides from the content it actually receives (all ten already return null on zero evidence). Rule: never guess which measurement a skipped input would affect from its name or shape; only the consumer that would use it can say whether its absence changes anything.
